invariants: Evaluation consumes the replayed prediction and the restored historical prediction.
Both archives contain the approved keys in order and equal dtypes, shapes, and values.
The receipt identifies both prediction archives and separates array parity from score parity.
A matching hold score cannot pass when any prediction array differs.
counterexamples: Changed prediction value with an unchanged hold score.
Missing prediction key in either archive.
Historical prediction with an unapproved byte identity.
